prompt:
Human: Given a molecular SMILES representation, predict the corresponding 13C NMR spectrum.

Spectrum format information:
- <13C_NMR>({frequency}, {solvent}) δ, shifts</13C_NMR>: Carbon-13 NMR spectrum showing chemical shifts
- <1H_NMR>({frequency}, {solvent}) δ {centroid:.2f} ({shape}{j_str}, {nH}H)</1H_NMR>: Proton NMR spectrum with chemical shifts, multiplicities, and integration
- <IR>(500~4000) freq(intensity)</IR>: Infrared spectrum with frequencies and intensities
- <ms_{mode}_fragments>{fragments}</ms_{mode}_fragments>: Mass spectrometry fragments
- <ms_positive_{energy_level}>{fragments}</ms_positive_{energy_level}>: Positive mode MS at specific collision energy
- <ms_negative_{energy_level}>{fragments}</ms_negative_{energy_level}>: Negative mode MS at specific collision energy

Please analyze the given SMILES and predict the 13C NMR spectrum. Output your prediction in the correct spectrum format with appropriate tags <13C_NMR></13C_NMR>.
<smiles>O=C(Nc1cccc(Oc2ccc3nc(NC(=O)C4CC4)cn3n2)c1)c1ccc(C(F)(F)F)cc1</smiles><|im_end|>
